## Overview

This notebook validates that simulating a birth-death process with a single birth
and death rate agrees with simulating the same process over three epochs when the
birth and death rates are identical in each epoch.

## Setup

```{python}
from typing import Any

import altair as alt
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display
from joblib import Parallel, delayed

from inf_bp_texts.analysis import (
    boundary_corrected_kde_on_support,
    proportion_not_at_upper,
    robust_y_max,
    theoretical_age_density,
)
from inf_bp_texts.models.math_ages import (
    calculate_non_spine_ages_log_lik,
    calculate_spine_ages_log_lik,
)
from inf_bp_texts.models.math_extinction import calculate_extinction_pr
from inf_bp_texts.models.math_populations import calculate_populations_log_pmf
from inf_bp_texts.simulation import simulate_birth_death_process
from inf_bp_texts.utils import derive_worker_seeds
from inf_bp_texts.visualization import save_chart
from inf_bp_texts.visualization.altair_theme import PTOLQUAL
```

## Simulate Age Vectors

```{python}
num_sims = 10000
birth_rate = 0.005
death_rate = birth_rate - 0.004
time_span = 1500.0
seed = 42
population_bin_width = 100

single_epoch_birth_rates = birth_rate
single_epoch_death_rates = death_rate
single_epoch_times = time_span

three_epoch_birth_rates = np.array([birth_rate, birth_rate, birth_rate], dtype=float)
three_epoch_death_rates = np.array([death_rate, death_rate, death_rate], dtype=float)
three_epoch_times = np.array([500.0, 1000.0, 1500.0], dtype=float)


def sample_age_vector_process(
    br: np.ndarray | float,
    dr: np.ndarray | float,
    span: np.ndarray | float,
    seed: int,
) -> np.ndarray:
    simulated_df = simulate_birth_death_process(
        birth_rates=br,
        death_rates=dr,
        times=span,
        random_seed=seed,
    )
    survivors = simulated_df.surviving_manuscripts
    assert survivors is not None
    if survivors.empty:
        return np.array([], dtype=np.float64)

    spine_ages = survivors.loc[survivors["is_spine"], "age"].to_numpy(
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    non_spine_ages = survivors.loc[~survivors["is_spine"], "age"].to_numpy(
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    if spine_ages.size > 0:
        return np.concatenate([spine_ages[:1], non_spine_ages]).astype(np.float64)
    return non_spine_ages.astype(np.float64)


single_epoch_seeds = derive_worker_seeds(seed, num_sims)
three_epoch_seeds = derive_worker_seeds(seed + 100_000, num_sims)

single_epoch_start = time.perf_counter()
list_of_ages_single_epoch = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
    delayed(sample_age_vector_process)(
        br=single_epoch_birth_rates,
        dr=single_epoch_death_rates,
        span=single_epoch_times,
        seed=single_epoch_seeds[i],
    )
    for i in range(num_sims)
)
single_epoch_seconds = time.perf_counter() - single_epoch_start

three_epoch_start = time.perf_counter()
list_of_ages_three_epoch = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
    delayed(sample_age_vector_process)(
        br=three_epoch_birth_rates,
        dr=three_epoch_death_rates,
        span=three_epoch_times,
        seed=three_epoch_seeds[i],
    )
    for i in range(num_sims)
)
three_epoch_seconds = time.perf_counter() - three_epoch_start

population_sizes_single_epoch = np.asarray(
    [len(ages) for ages in list_of_ages_single_epoch],
    dtype=np.int64,
)
population_sizes_three_epoch = np.asarray(
    [len(ages) for ages in list_of_ages_three_epoch],
    dtype=np.int64,
)

rows = []
for method_name, ages_list, population_sizes in [
    (
        "single-epoch process",
        list_of_ages_single_epoch,
        population_sizes_single_epoch,
    ),
    (
        "three-epoch process",
        list_of_ages_three_epoch,
        population_sizes_three_epoch,
    ),
]:
    rows.append(
        {
            "method": method_name,
            "n_sims": int(len(ages_list)),
            "mean_population": float(np.mean(population_sizes)),
            "extinct_fraction": float((population_sizes == 0).mean()),
            "mean_age": float(
                np.nanmean(
                    [
                        float(np.mean(ages)) if len(ages) else np.nan
                        for ages in ages_list
                    ]
                )
            ),
        }
    )

summary_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

print(f"Simulations per method: {num_sims}")
print(f"Sampling time (single-epoch process): {single_epoch_seconds:.2f}s")
print(f"Sampling time (three-epoch process): {three_epoch_seconds:.2f}s")
print(
    f"Theoretical extinct fraction: {calculate_extinction_pr(birth_rate, death_rate, time_span):.3f}"
)
print(summary_df.to_string(index=False, float_format="%.3f"))
print(
    f"\nSingle-epoch spine ages count: {sum(1 for ages in list_of_ages_single_epoch if len(ages) > 0 and ages[0] < time_span)}"
)
print(
    f"Three-epoch spine ages count: {sum(1 for ages in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(ages) > 0 and ages[0] < time_span)}"
)
print(
    f"Single-epoch non-spine ages count: {sum(len(ages) - 1 for ages in list_of_ages_single_epoch if len(ages) > 1)}"
)
print(
    f"Three-epoch non-spine ages count: {sum(len(ages) - 1 for ages in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(ages) > 1)}"
)
```

## Population Distribution

```{python}
population_max = int(
    max(
        population_sizes_single_epoch.max(),
        population_sizes_three_epoch.max(),
        1,
    ),
)
population_bin_edges = np.arange(
    0,
    population_max + population_bin_width,
    population_bin_width,
    dtype=np.float64,
)
if population_bin_edges[-1] < population_max + 1:
    population_bin_edges = np.append(
        population_bin_edges, population_bin_edges[-1] + population_bin_width
    )
population_bin_centers = (population_bin_edges[:-1] + population_bin_edges[1:]) / 2.0

population_empirical_counts_single, _ = np.histogram(
    population_sizes_single_epoch,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
)
population_empirical_counts_three, _ = np.histogram(
    population_sizes_three_epoch,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
)

population_support = np.arange(0, population_max + 1, dtype=np.int64)
population_pmf = np.asarray(
    jnp.exp(
        calculate_populations_log_pmf(
            birth_rates=jnp.array([birth_rate]),
            death_rates=jnp.array([death_rate]),
            ns=jnp.array(population_support, dtype=jnp.float64),
            times=jnp.array([time_span]),
        )
    )
)

population_theoretical_counts, _ = np.histogram(
    population_support,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
    weights=population_pmf * num_sims,
)

_pop_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
for bc, cnt_s, cnt_t in zip(
    population_bin_centers,
    population_empirical_counts_single,
    population_empirical_counts_three,
):
    _pop_records += [
        {
            "bin": float(bc),
            "count": int(cnt_s),
            "method": "Observed (single-epoch process)",
        },
        {
            "bin": float(bc),
            "count": int(cnt_t),
            "method": "Observed (three-epoch process)",
        },
    ]
_pop_df = pd.DataFrame(_pop_records)
_theory_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "bin": population_bin_centers.tolist(),
        "count": population_theoretical_counts.tolist(),
    }
)

_pop_color = alt.Scale(
    domain=["Observed (single-epoch process)", "Observed (three-epoch process)"],
    range=[PTOLQUAL[0], PTOLQUAL[2]],
)
_pop_bars = (
    alt.Chart(_pop_df)
    .mark_bar(opacity=0.65)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("bin:Q", title="Population size", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[0, 2000])),
        y=alt.Y("count:Q", title="Count"),
        xOffset="method:N",
        color=alt.Color(
            "method:N", scale=_pop_color, legend=alt.Legend(title=None, orient="top")
        ),
    )
)
_theory_line = (
    alt.Chart(_theory_df)
    .mark_line(
        point=alt.OverlayMarkDef(size=25, color=PTOLQUAL[1]),
        strokeDash=[4, 2],
        strokeWidth=2,
        color=PTOLQUAL[1],
    )
    .encode(x=alt.X("bin:Q"), y=alt.Y("count:Q"))
)
fig_population = (_pop_bars + _theory_line).properties(
    title="Population Distribution: Single-Epoch Process vs Three-Epoch Process",
    width=600,
    height=350,
)
display(fig_population)
save_chart(
    fig_population, "methods_validation_population_distribution", width=600, height=350
)
print("Saved population figure")
```

## Spine and Non-Spine Age Checks

```{python}
spine_age_samples_single = np.asarray(
    [
        arr[0]
        for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch
        if len(arr) > 0 and arr[0] < time_span
    ],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_age_samples_three = np.asarray(
    [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(arr) > 0 and arr[0] < time_span],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_age_samples_all = np.asarray(
    [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch if len(arr) > 0]
    + [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(arr) > 0],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_prop_not_at_max = proportion_not_at_upper(spine_age_samples_all, time_span)

non_spine_age_samples_single = (
    np.concatenate([arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch if len(arr) > 1])
    if any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch)
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_age_samples_three = (
    np.concatenate([arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(arr) > 1])
    if any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch)
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_age_samples_all = (
    np.concatenate(
        [arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch if len(arr) > 1]
        + [arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch if len(arr) > 1],
    )
    if (
        any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_single_epoch)
        or any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_three_epoch)
    )
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_prop_not_at_max = proportion_not_at_upper(
    non_spine_age_samples_all, time_span
)

non_spine_grid_single, non_spine_kde_single = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    non_spine_age_samples_single,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
non_spine_grid_three, non_spine_kde_three = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    non_spine_age_samples_three,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
non_spine_theory_x, non_spine_theory_y = theoretical_age_density(
    lambda age: calculate_non_spine_ages_log_lik(  # pyright: ignore[reportUnknownLambdaType]
        birth_rates=birth_rate, death_rates=death_rate, ages=age, times=time_span
    ),
    time_span,
    proportion_not_at_upper=non_spine_prop_not_at_max,
)
spine_grid_single, spine_kde_single = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    spine_age_samples_single,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
spine_grid_three, spine_kde_three = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    spine_age_samples_three,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
spine_theory_x, spine_theory_y = theoretical_age_density(
    lambda age: calculate_spine_ages_log_lik(  # pyright: ignore[reportUnknownLambdaType]
        birth_rates=birth_rate, death_rates=death_rate, ages=age, times=time_span
    ),
    time_span,
    include_endpoint=False,
    proportion_not_at_upper=spine_prop_not_at_max,
)

non_spine_y_max = robust_y_max(
    [non_spine_kde_single, non_spine_kde_three, non_spine_theory_y]
)
spine_y_max = robust_y_max([spine_kde_single, spine_kde_three, spine_theory_y])


def _kde_panel(
    kde_x: np.ndarray | None,
    kde_y: np.ndarray | None,
    theory_x: np.ndarray,
    theory_y: np.ndarray,
    color: str,
    panel_title: str,
    x_label: str,
    y_label: str,
    y_domain: list[float],
) -> alt.LayerChart:
    x_dom = [0.0, float(time_span)]
    layers: list[alt.Chart] = []
    if kde_x is not None and kde_y is not None:
        kde_df = pd.DataFrame({"Age": kde_x.tolist(), "Density": kde_y.tolist()})
        layers.append(
            alt.Chart(kde_df)
            .mark_area(
                opacity=0.4, color=color, line={"color": color, "strokeWidth": 2}
            )
            .encode(
                x=alt.X("Age:Q", title=x_label, scale=alt.Scale(domain=x_dom)),
                y=alt.Y("Density:Q", title=y_label, scale=alt.Scale(domain=y_domain)),
            )
        )
    theory_df = pd.DataFrame({"Age": theory_x.tolist(), "Density": theory_y.tolist()})
    layers.append(
        alt.Chart(theory_df)
        .mark_line(strokeDash=[4, 2], color=PTOLQUAL[1], strokeWidth=2)
        .encode(
            x=alt.X("Age:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=x_dom)),
            y=alt.Y("Density:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=y_domain)),
        )
    )
    return alt.layer(*layers).properties(title=panel_title, width=280, height=200)


ns_dom = [0.0, non_spine_y_max]
sp_dom = [0.0, spine_y_max]
fig_summary = alt.vconcat(
    alt.hconcat(
        _kde_panel(
            non_spine_grid_single,
            non_spine_kde_single,
            non_spine_theory_x,
            non_spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[0],
            "Single-epoch process",
            "Age (single-epoch process)",
            "Density (non-spine)",
            ns_dom,
        ),
        _kde_panel(
            non_spine_grid_three,
            non_spine_kde_three,
            non_spine_theory_x,
            non_spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[2],
            "Three-epoch process",
            "Age (three-epoch process)",
            "",
            ns_dom,
        ),
    ),
    alt.hconcat(
        _kde_panel(
            spine_grid_single,
            spine_kde_single,
            spine_theory_x,
            spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[0],
            "Single-epoch process",
            "Age (single-epoch process)",
            "Density (spine)",
            sp_dom,
        ),
        _kde_panel(
            spine_grid_three,
            spine_kde_three,
            spine_theory_x,
            spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[2],
            "Three-epoch process",
            "Age (three-epoch process)",
            "",
            sp_dom,
        ),
    ),
).properties(title="Age Densities by Generator (Single-Epoch vs Three-Epoch Process)")
display(fig_summary)
save_chart(fig_summary, "methods_validation_age_densities")
print("Saved age-density figure")
```

The density of the spine age distribution does not include the point mass at the maximum time span.

import json
import os

doc_name = "methods_validation_multi_epoch_simulation_checks.qmd"

    data = json.loads(compile_log.read_text()) if compile_log.exists() else {}
except Exception:

data[doc_name] = {"duration_seconds": duration_seconds, "timestamp": timestamp}
